shortDescription: Ask DeepSeek or MiMo on demand
longDescription: Bridges DeepSeek (deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro) and Xiaomi MiMo (mimo-v2.6-pro / mimo-v2.6-flash) into Kimi as tools: when you need a second opinion, a code review, or a different model's view, hand the question to the model you name and get back its full answer plus reasoning, then let Kimi summarise it. One model per request — the two never answer the same question together. API keys are reused from DeepSeek Harness credentials.
tryPrompts: Ask DeepSeek to review this code for real problems
Try MiMo on my previous question for comparison
Ask DeepSeek what could go wrong with this plan

bridge.description: Ask DeepSeek or MiMo a single question (one model at a time)

deepseek-mimo-consult.description: When to call DeepSeek vs MiMo, how to pick parameters, and how to debug failures
